baseDir.description: Default base directory for every entry. Relative to the config file.

logLevel.description: Verbosity of diagnostic messages written to stderr. Defaults to 'silent'. The CLI --log-level flag overrides this.

tsconfig.description: Resolve bare imports through the nearest tsconfig.json (compilerOptions.paths / baseUrl, following extends). Defaults to true. The CLI --no-tsconfig flag forces it off.

failOnUnresolved.description: Exit non-zero when the number of unresolved imports exceeds this threshold. true means 0. The CLI --fail-on-unresolved flag overrides this.

entry.description: Path to the entry file, relative to baseDir. May also be a glob (e.g. 'src/**/*.ts'); every match is hashed and the results are folded into a single deterministic hash for this entry.

extras.description: Additional files whose content should be folded into the hash (e.g. package.json, lockfiles). Entries may be literal paths or glob patterns.

baseDir.description: Per-entry base directory. Overrides the top-level baseDir for this entry.

entries.description: Named entries to hash. Keys appear in the CLI output.

description: Configuration for the hashup CLI. Lives in hashup.json.
title: Hashup Config
